description: Ontario employee, federal + provincial income tax + CPP + EI at $8,000/month. state_income_tax was originally $448.83, independently verified live against a real database in an earlier session of this project (2026-09-07 restoration work) under the legacy deduction method (the platform's only-ever default at that time). Updated 2026-09-11 (gap-closure Phase 1): the CRA-correct credit method (ZP-TAX-CA-2026-001 §7's 'T3 = (R×A) − K') plus the federal K2/K3 CPP/EI credit are now enabled by default. This income genuinely crosses a federal bracket (58,523) and an Ontario bracket (53,891), which is exactly the condition under which the credit and deduction methods are documented to diverge (engine/countries/shared.py's own _CA_CREDIT_METHOD_ENABLED_COUNTRIES comment) — federal_income_tax and state_income_tax below are the new figures, recomputed by running the real engine (not hand-derived), not a fresh guess either.
source: ZP-TAX-CA-2026-001 v1.0: Section 6 (federal brackets/BPAF/CEA, same as federal_only_flat_gross_4000.json), Section 8 (Ontario 2026 brackets: 53,891/107,785/150,000/220,000 at 5.05/9.15/11.16/12.16/13.16%, Ontario basic amount $12,989), Section 10-11 (CPP/EI, same rates as the federal-only case). Hand-verified against the document's own bracket tables and cross-checked by running the actual engine at authoring time -- not run through CRA PDOC.
